Maya Patel: Quick run-of-show draft for Wed customer-case webinar — trying to lock speakers + routing.
Liam Chen: thanks — can you paste the schedule?
Maya Patel: Sure, pasted below. Short intro, 3 customer stories (10m each), benchmarks demo (10), live q&a (15), close + CTA (5).
Olivia Rivera: Who is owning slide deck collab? I can host Google Slides.
Maya Patel: @Olivia that'd be great. I'll add speaker notes. Slides: https://redwood-inference.com/slides/customer-case
Samir Noor: For the benchmarks demo we need a fallback video if infra flaps. Sam can run demo or swap to recorded 3-min clip.
Liam Chen: Also define lead routing: qualify via poll, mark heavy-usage leads to Enterprise queue.
Maya Patel: Routing plan: use webinar form -> tag 'benchmark-interest' -> send to /sales/enterprise if token>1M monthly.
Grace (Sales): Confirmed. We'll pick up 'enterprise' tags within 24h and assign AE.
WebinarBot: Reminder: rehearsal scheduled Tue 11:00 PT. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.
Olivia Rivera: Tue 11 works for speakers? @Samir @Liam
Samir Noor: Can do. I'll bring the fallback video and script.
Liam Chen: Need a 20-min tech dry run before the rehearsal to test model endpoints and streaming.
Maya Patel: Good call. Let's do 10:40 PT quick smoke test on prod-dedicated. Samir/Olivia/Liam please join.
Olivia Rivera: Adding run-of-show as code block below.
Olivia Rivera: ```
10:40 PT — Tech smoke (20m) — model endpoint, streaming, audio
11:00 PT — Rehearsal (60m)
  11:00-11:05 — Welcome + quick intro (Maya)
  11:05-11:15 — Customer 1 (Olivia)
  11:15-11:25 — Customer 2 (Liam)
  11:25-11:35 — Customer 3 (Samir)
  11:35-11:45 — Benchmarks demo (Samir) — live or fallback video
  11:45-11:55 — Live Q&A (panel)
  11:55-12:00 — Close + CTA (Maya)
```
Maya Patel: Thanks. Also we should A/B the CTA — 'trial credits' vs 'dedicated consult' — need signup links.
Grace (Sales): We'll prepare two routing flows in HubSpot; share sample links by EOD Mon.
Maya Patel: Final ask: speakers send slides by Mon 9am. I'll compile and share rehearsal deck by Mon noon.
Liam Chen: :thumbsup: 
WebinarBot: Event created: https://redwood-inference.com/events/customer-case-webinar — 2026-05-12 17:00 UTC
